about: Parts of OPTIONAL narration. None of them is in the wheel, the sdist or the default container image. build.py adds them to every release SBOM with scope 'excluded' (not in this artifact) so their licences are on record. eSpeak NG is GPL-3.0: any published image that includes it must ship the licence text and a source offer (see the narration target in the Dockerfile). The install pins are composer/narration/requirements.lock (universal, hash-locked; on Python 3.10 it resolves onnxruntime 1.24.3 and numpy 2.2.6, from 3.11 the versions below).

components.name: kokoro-onnx
components.delivery: installed only when narration is chosen (native setup) or in the opt-in narration image

components.name: espeakng-loader
components.delivery: installed only with narration; it bundles the eSpeak NG library listed next

components.name: espeak-ng
components.delivery: native library inside the espeakng-loader wheel; GPL-3.0 licence text and a source offer ship with any image that includes it
